b: I’ll call my fiancé Liam and his best friend Gigi, and her parents Penny and Jack.

Liam and I have been together 4 years, engaged six months. When we first met, Liam told me about his family, how he isn’t close with his bio family due to serious issues, and how the closest thing he has to parents are the parents of his best friend, Gigi. I thought that was really sweet. I move had similar struggles with my family and I wish I’d found people to fill that void the way Liam has.

When I finally met Gigi, I was so ready to like her, the way Liam described her, she was an angel on earth. Turns out, while she’s extremely likeable and smart, she’s also extremely spoiled, to the point where hanging out with her is exhausting. And when she’s around Liam is exhausting too because he plays along with it. Being out with them is like being a third wheel when you barely know the two other people, their rhythm is just very different to our normal one. Which ok fine, people have friends and not all your friends will be mutual. But he sees her at least twice a week so either I tag along occasionally or I’m missing out on seeing him.

And Gigi I could probably handle, because you don’t like all your spouse’s friends necessarily, right. But then there’s the parents. These two are the probably the coldest people I’ve ever met in my life. Not rude exactly, just icy. They seem to have zero interest in getting to know me, never ask me questions, every time I see them I feel like I’m intruding, even in my own home. Penny especially looks at me like Liam scraped me off the sidewalk and brought me home…which…ironic much? When we got engaged we called her and Jack to tell them, and Penny had a face like she’d swallowed a whole lemon, and after finding out I was the one who proposed, Jack was like oh well that’s one way to get what you want. I know it was a joke but Jesus. They haven’t mentioned the engagement since. Seeing them always leaves me feeling worse than seeing my own family, where I’m the black sheep too.

And it’s easy to say I shouldn’t Care what they think, and I don’t really, but when I think of spending Christmas with them, I get a pit in my stomach. I think of these being my future child’s grandparents, probably the only ones they’ll ever see regularly. I think of not having my family there on my wedding day and having these people instead, just making me feel worse. And I just don’t want it.

I’ve spoken to Liam before about how uncomfortable I feel, and he doesn’t get it. Or maybe he does but he always just says they’re the closest thing he has to family, they’ve done everything for him when they didn’t have to, and he doesn’t want to throw that away. Which if I’m honest feels even worse because it shows they do have the capacity to be warm and loving to people who aren’t blood, just once again I’m not considered good enough for that.

it’s really just dampening my excitement for the wedding but also for our life together. And I know a lot of that is probably my own issues surrounding family, I get that, but it doesn’t change the fact that I just can’t se building a life with these people as such a huge part of it, especially when this is going to be “our” only extended family. I don’t want to make Liam choose, or cut him off from them. I guess I just want some advice on how to look at this to make it less daunting, or what boundaries I could put in place to feel better, or whether this is definitely going to be a dealbreaker in the future and I’m wasting my time. Basically any advice from people who’ve dealt with something similar would be appreciated.
TLDR: I don’t feel comfortable around my fiancé’s ‘family’ and I don’t think they like me either. the idea of spending my life around them is making me reconsider our future.
